# The Mexico Review

> Independent editorial guide to destinations, restaurants, hotels and experiences in Mexico. Primary language: Mexican Spanish (es-MX); English edition also available.

## Published destination guides
- [Inicio · Español](https://themexicoreview.com/)
- [Home · English](https://themexicoreview.com/en/)
- [Cancún · ES](https://themexicoreview.com/cancun/)
- [Cancún · EN](https://themexicoreview.com/en/cancun/)
- [Ciudad de México · ES](https://themexicoreview.com/mexico-city/)
- [Mexico City · EN](https://themexicoreview.com/en/mexico-city/)
- [Los Cabos · ES](https://themexicoreview.com/los-cabos/)
- [Los Cabos · EN](https://themexicoreview.com/en/los-cabos/)

## Editorial scope and verification
- Reviews must be supported by verifiable first-hand evidence where they describe lived experiences.
- Best Of lists and annual awards will be published only when adequate evaluation supports them. No recipients have been named.
- Category landing pages are still being developed and do not contain verified rankings.
- This is a navigation aid for agents, not a substitute for the canonical HTML pages or sitemap.
